m.external_lines.market_note: Entire calculation is a de-vigged sportsbook/exchange price; benchmark only, there is no market-free rebuild because the quantity is the market.
m.external_lines.measurement_fix: For each match with a free-file close: p_book = two-way de-vig of Pinnacle close (power method: solve k so 1/o1^k... sums to 1; Shin only for 3-way sets; fall back to average close if Pinnacle missing). Compare to the Kalshi mid from the candlestick whose end time is the last one at or before the book file's stated close time; if the file gives no timestamp, use Kalshi last pre-start candle and label the comparison close-vs-close only. Output diff = kalshi_mid - p_book and sign persistence = share of consecutive matching snapshots with the same sign. Use for benchmarking only.

m.fees.assessment: Execution constant, not a predictor. As written no formula is given, so it is not computable. Fee schedule changes over time and maker fees differ; the schedule must be versioned by trade date to avoid applying a current schedule to history.

m.fees.market_note: The fee function itself is rule-based and market-free, but net edge subtracts a market price and spread; use the fee table alone as a market-free input.
m.fees.measurement_fix: Implement fee(price p in dollars, contracts C, role, trade_date) from the schedule in force on trade_date; for the standard taker schedule fee = ceil_to_cent(0.07 * C * p * (1 - p)), maker fee per the schedule row (often 0 or 0.0175 coefficient) and verify both coefficients against the archived schedule. Net edge per contract = model_p - fill_price - fee/C - (slippage vs mid). Report the net-of-fee break-even probability gap by price bucket. As-of: trade timestamp.

m.ladder_structure.assessment: Cross-rung consistency is a trading structure input; useful only if rungs are captured at one timestamp (historical candlesticks are not synchronous, so snapshots must come from own capture or aligned candles). m.ladder_structure.market_note: Computed entirely from Kalshi rung mid prices; benchmark/trading-structure only. A market-free analogue is the model-only game-margin PMF (ten.game_margin_pmf_calibration).
m.ladder_structure.measurement_fix: For one event at a single timestamp t (candles aligned to the same 1-minute bucket, rungs with no trade in 10 min dropped): list cumulative prices P(D>k) for ascending k; flag any non-monotone pair (P_k < P_{k+1}); fit pmf over integer D by minimising sum_k w_k (mid_k - P(D>k;theta))^2 where theta are the two hold probabilities of a set-level DP game-margin model and w_k = 1/(spread_k)^2; record per-rung residual mid_k - fitted and the fitted pmf. Never use quotes after market start.

ten.ball_change_cycle.measurement_fix: Register per event-year: first_change_after = a (e.g. 7 or 9), interval = b (9 or 11), warmup_counts flag. Games played before game g = g-1; new balls are used in game g iff g-1 >= a and (g-1-a) mod b == 0; fresh = that indicator. Estimate delta_hold = coefficient on fresh in logit(hold) ~ server + returner + surface + event + fresh from Slam point-by-point (game level), report as change in hold probability (pp), shrunk to 0 with n/(n+500) games. Event not in register -> missing, not imputed.

ten.bo5_rating_premium.measurement_fix: For each Slam bo5 match, expected win prob E_5 = F(Elo gap) where F is a bo5 transform of the bo3-fitted win prob (via set-win prob s solved from bo3 prob, then bo5 formula). residual_i = sum over player's last up to 60 bo5 matches before as-of with weights 0.5^(age_days/1095) of (result - E_5), divided by the weighted sum of E_5(1-E_5) and by ln10/400 to convert to Elo points, then shrunk by n_eff/(n_eff+25) toward 0. Add the premium to the Elo gap only in best_of=5 matches. As-of: before the event's first match.

ten.withdrawal_hazard_timeline.measurement_fix: Unit = (player listed at entry deadline). Intervals: I1 entry deadline to draw, I2 draw to order-of-play, I3 order-of-play to first ball. Hazard_k = P(withdraw in I_k | still in at start of I_k) by discrete-time logistic with covariates event category (Slam/Masters/500/250/Challenger), rank band (1-10,11-30,31-60,61+), age bin, days since last match; ridge equivalent to n/(n+30). Training data only from own-captured snapshots plus archived lists; as-of = snapshot vintage time.

ten.within_match_serve_decay.assessment: Set-level spw is not in the Sackmann match CSV (match totals only), so the definition must be limited to Slam point-by-point; covariate effects (age, heat, prior minutes) need a regression, not just an average.

ten.within_match_serve_decay.measurement_fix: From Slam point-by-point compute spw_set_k per player in bo5 matches lasting >=3 sets; decay_k = spw_{k+1} - spw_k per player-match. Pooled mixed model decay ~ set_index + age>=33 + prior_match_minutes>200 + heat_flag + (1|player); player estimate = pooled prediction + player random effect shrunk n/(n+25) toward 0. Use only matches before as-of; report expected spw change by set index.
